newsitem.title: FRANCE: One ship loading barley for Saudis in Rouen.
newsitem.headline: One ship loading barley for Saudis in Rouen.

text.p: One ship was currently loading in Rouen 47,000 tonnes of barley destined for Saudi Arabia, port officials said on Tuesday.
A ship was also expected by September 28 in Rouen to load some 25,000 tonnes of barley, they said. The destination was not specified.
Industry sources suggested the shipments were part of a recent sale of European Union barley to Saudi Arabia.
Saudi Arabia bought in late August 800,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for shipment in September and October.
The bulk of the purchase was expected to come from the European Union.
The European Commission has helped cover part of the sale from German barley intervention stocks but started recently to grant barley exports from the free market.
On Monday Saudi Arabia bought a further 1.4 million tonnes of barley for shipment between October and December.
